## 学校共用申请资料

以下是已核实的学校规则，适用资格与年度在各条中说明；具体专业还可能要求先修科目、考试、作品集或另行申请。

### 入学条件

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>课程与中国资格缺口：</strong>当前已读英国校区课程页分别列A-level／IB要求；中国普高／高考通用转换页本轮未取得。不得使用宁波或马来西亚校区条件代替英国校区。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-UKENR-36ebd0aa2cabe8">官方依据</a></p>

### 申请安排

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>2027 UCAS常规周期：</strong>适用UCAS常规截止的2027本科须在2027年1月13日英国18:00前提交以获得平等审理；医学、牙科、兽医等部分课程在2026年10月15日早截止。课程可另有特殊渠道，考试报名和材料日期另核。2026年9月12日核验时常规截止尚未到。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-UKENR-6ff2a5ce1a9f38">官方依据</a> · <a href="#source-u-UKENR-f5da9307fd5b4a">官方依据</a></p>

### 学费与资助

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>2027/28英国校区：</strong>费用规则明确新生的2027/28课程或学习阶段金额会写入录取信；中国及马来西亚校区另向相应校区查询。本批课程金额按实际页面标明年度记录。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-u-UKENR-4f8c14e99c914b">官方依据</a></p>

### 学校资料来源

**官方目录仍在补齐**，共 222 项；这不是全字段详情的完成状态。

<p><strong>统计范围：</strong>Apply same visibility rule as official course-grid JS；Remove terminal entry-year suffix only when identifying duplicate intake versions of one courseId；Keep separate courseId/UCAS variants; do not collapse by title；Never convert Clearing flags into general future admissions status</p>

<p><strong>对账方法：</strong>[{&quot;endpoint&quot;: &quot;/bin/uon/coursepages.json&quot;, &quot;array&quot;: &quot;Facilities&quot;, &quot;received&quot;: 416, &quot;paging&quot;: &quot;Official UI loads entire array and paginates locally at 32 records/page&quot;, &quot;official_visibility_rule&quot;: &quot;title &amp;&amp; startDate &amp;&amp; hideinsitemap !== true&quot;, &quot;unique_base_course_ids&quot;: 222, &quot;earlier_intake_versions_removed&quot;: 194, &quot;current2027&quot;: 201}]</p>

<p><strong>排除项：</strong>Apply same visibility rule as official course-grid JS；Remove terminal entry-year suffix only when identifying duplicate intake versions of one courseId；Keep separate courseId/UCAS variants; do not collapse by title；Never convert Clearing flags into general future admissions status</p>

- Index listing does not by itself confirm applications remain open.
- Scope is the published UK undergraduate directory feed; Malaysia and Ningbo campus catalogues are not established as covered by this feed.
